newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan gold rates seen easing after devaluation.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan gold rates seen easing after devaluation.

text.p: Pakistan gold rates, which rose sharply after last week's devaluation of the rupee by 7.86 percent against the dollar, are likely to ease in the next few days before firming again, dealers said on Monday.
Gold, which rose 277 rupees to 5,309 per 10 grams of 24 carat gold after the devaluation, closed eight rupees lower at 5,301 in dull trading on Sunday, one dealer said.
"It is a temporary phenomenon and gold rates are likely to rise again," the dealer said.
Silver prices were unchanged and likely to remain steady this week with little demand, he said.
